decision: Close fencing token 5 after complete lower49 preauthority classification, preserve two relationship-sensitive cases for a fresh authority-eligible review, and declare PR #334's Delta relationship artifact the canonical preauthority decision surface while retaining PR #333 as superseded historical evidence.
rationale: The exact lower49 queue is fully classified at preauthority level: 47 records have current public distinctness evidence, Neu-Schönstatt has a strong same-property candidate requiring authority review, and Delta Resort Apartments has a same-operator/same-license adjacent-subinventory relationship whose canonical granularity cannot be chosen under token 5. Continuing token 5 would exceed its bounded PREAUTH authority ceiling. Concurrent compatible Delta artifacts would become a hidden dual source of truth unless precedence were made explicit.
alternatives_rejected: Keep token 5 active indefinitely after its bounded preauthority scope is complete
Promote Neu-Schönstatt to H-0114 from preauthority evidence
Collapse Delta Resort Apartments into H-0220 from relationship evidence
Allocate or reserve H-0691 for any staged/new entity
Delete either concurrent Delta artifact and lose historical provenance
Treat the richer PR #334 and later PR #333 artifacts as co-authoritative preauthority surfaces
revisit_condition: Revisit only with a fresh authority-eligible claim that can adjudicate existing-target identity/granularity and then run the required source-mapping rebuild plus cross-plane reconciliation.
